subject: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage

Team —

Per QBR cadence, I want a concise snapshot of where product + engineering are on the top launch slate and the realistic timeline we should present to the execs on Monday. Please keep updates short and stick to the template in the Drive link (attached):
- Current milestone status (Green/Yellow/Red)
- Predicted ship window (by week) and blockers to that window
- Primary mitigation we can commit to in 72 hours
- Any customer-facing risks that require sales/CS coordination

Attachments: QBR-roadmap-snapshot-2028-06-10.pdf; launch-risk-heatmap-2028-06-10.xlsx

Agenda for the sync I’ll run Friday at 10am PT: align on one conservative timeline, confirm top-3 risks, and agree canaries we will show execs. If you cannot make it, reply with your inputs inline.

Thanks —
Lauren
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage

Lauren —

Quick status from Product: attaching the snapshot with updated statuses. Highlights: 
- Feature Slate A (GigaRetail integration): Yellow — dependence on their SSO and procurement timeline. Current ship target: week of 2028-08-13. Blocker: procurement SLA and SSO cert exchange (owner: Sales/Partner). Mitigation (72h): get PO cadence confirmed with Anna and procurement; I’ll drop a short MAP and confirm required artifacts.
- Feature Slate B (Optimize routing): Green — on track for week of 2028-07-30 but we have one unresolved perf regression in long-tail queries; Eng has a patch candidate.
- Feature Slate C (Dedicate deploy API): Red — infra scale test failed last week, ETA to resolve depends on Karthik’s bandwidth.

Customer-facing risk: GigaRetail timeline slips could push a pilot beyond quarter; Anna has been flexible but procurement is the unknown. I’ve CC’d Anna in a later thread to ask for the PO timing.

Action items for Friday: I propose we present a single conservative timeline that shows GigaRetail as "targeting Q3 but contingent on procurement" and present an ops fallback (limited pilot with synthetic creds) if SSO delays extend beyond two weeks.

—Monica
Senior Director, Product
[Attachment: QBR-roadmap-snapshot-2028-06-10.pdf]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage

Monica —

Engineering update (brief):
- Dedicate deploy API (Feature Slate C) failed scale gate due to memory pressure in the allocator path; reproducer attached in the ticket. Root cause narrow: our allocator does not compact well under the mixed-small-batch workload.
- Bandwidth: two SRE engineers are tied up on an enterprise customer incident until EOW; we do have a patch for the allocator that reduces peak by ~18% but it requires regression test run on staging (48h) + a canary in prod region for 72h.

Proposed timeline: move Dedicate API to a controlled canary start 2028-07-02, full rollout tentatively 2028-07-23 if canary looks clean. If we need to accelerate, we can temp-scale with an extra NVM pool but that will add cost and require an SLA exception from Ops.

Mitigations to commit within 72h: 1) schedule regression run and canary window, 2) enable transient NVM pool as a guarded fallback (requires Ops signoff), 3) prepare rollback playbook.

I’ve added the heatmap row for the allocator under "Dedicate API" in the attached spreadsheet.

—Karthik
Director, Engineering
[Attachment referenced: launch-risk-heatmap-2028-06-10.xlsx]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-11T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage

Thanks team — strong, practical updates. A couple of leadership asks before Friday’s brief: 
1) Consolidate: Lauren, can you and Monica produce a single-page slide that shows the conservative timeline (one column: target week; second: probability bucket; third: mitigation committed). I want that in the QBR deck.
2) Escalation: Dedicate API is now a top-3 delivery risk. Please prepare a two-line exec ask: what additional headcount or SLA exception is required, and what is the delta to unit economics if we take the transient NVM fallback.
3) Customer: Anna (GigaRetail) should not see internal contingency language. Monica — please coordinate a neutral status note and the MAP doc that outlines dependencies and deliverables. Tag Sales to own procurement follow-up.

I’ll be at the Friday session; if Dedicate API remains red, we will recommend a targeted investment to clear the gate rather than push the timeline.

Vivek
SVP, Product & Strategy
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Anna Jensen <anna@gigaretail.com>
Cc: procurement@gigaretail.com
Date: 2028-06-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q3 QBR prep — roadmap posture, launch timelines, and delivery risk triage

Anna / GigaRetail team —

Following up with a brief, neutral status note and the mutual action plan that outlines the artifacts we need to start the pilot. We’re aiming for an initial integration window in mid-August, subject to procurement and SSO cert exchange. Attached: mutual-action-plan-gigaretail-v1.docx (actionable items and owners).

Internal note to team: please do not include internal mitigation language when sharing with the customer. Sales/SRE will coordinate the cert exchange next week.

Next steps (internal):
- Monica: finalize single-page timeline slide by EOD Thursday.
- Karthik: book canary regression window and list exact Ops permission you need to enable fallback NVM pool (deadline: Wed COB).
- Neha: include a one-line risk statement and recommended exec ask for Friday’s QBR pack.

Lauren
VP, Product Operations
[Forwarded attachment: mutual-action-plan-gigaretail-v1.docx]
